notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Unpublish Object Class Attributes service in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The registry removes selected ordinary publication state only after it has checked the pending-acquisition precondition, then synchronously clears corresponding ownership. Its focused production-filesystem regression adds the successful-void service-report boundary: an undefined object class appends nothing, while an accepted post-publication unpublish appends type-36 ObjectClassHandle and type-1 optional AttributeHandleSet arguments before any separately queued declaration advisories. The Requirements Lab currently assigns the §5.3 service-body candidates on its coalesced source page to clause-5.3.3; RL-078 records that ownership mismatch while service/test descriptions retain the direct §5.3 source context. Whole-class unpublication, complete ownership/acquisition matrices, discovery, advisory delivery, MOM interaction delivery, timestamped behavior, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
